lines.text: A synagogue leader named Jairus fell at Jesus' feet and pleaded for his little daughter, so Jesus went with him.
A woman bleeding for seven years came up behind Jesus and touched His cloak, and her bleeding stopped immediately.
Jesus knew power had gone out from Him, and He told the trembling woman her faith had healed her.
Messengers said Jairus's daughter was dead, and Jesus let only Peter, James, and Andrew go with Him.
Jesus took the girl by the hand and told her to get up, and she began to walk around.
